scientific_integrity: Exact rational witness and self-contained spectral proof; numerical code is supplementary, not proof of universal shape claims.
scientific_limitations: Constant ventilation and positive first-order reversible direct-air pool exchange; nonlinear sorption, chemistry and field calibration are excluded. Historical priority beyond inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: Minimal desorption-rate diversity and an exact two-pool rebound criterion in source-free indoor air
